summary: netapp.cloudmanager was removed as unmaintained and cyberark.pas for repeated inclusion violations; both can still be installed with ansible-galaxy.
questions: Why was cyberark.pas removed from Ansible?

answer_card.title: Why cyberark.pas and netapp.cloudmanager were removed
answer_card.answer_md:
- **netapp.cloudmanager:** unmaintained. Install with `ansible-galaxy collection install netapp.cloudmanager`.
- **cyberark.pas:** repeatedly violated inclusion requirements (including repository management) and maintainers didn't respond. Install with `ansible-galaxy collection install cyberark.pas`.
